file_reviews.assessment: Audited Section 3 host bounds, resource fences, Python native seam specifications, adapter pins, and legacy functional boundary retirements.
Audited rows P4-06 (host bounds and timeout metadata), P4-07 (Python native seam), P4-08 (graph tutorial adapter pin), and P4-11 (legacy command refusal).
Audited read_request_prefix bounded stream reading, MAX_HOST_REQUEST_BYTES limit, and request size refusal logic.
Audited MAX_CARRIER_DIMENSION, MAX_DENSE_MATRIX_CELLS, and validate_carrier_resource_fence preallocation bounds.
Audited evaluate_request_bytes byte limit checks, validate_budgets_and_carrier timeout validation (1..=300000 ms), and absence of internal watchdog timers.
Audited library root export boundaries, host types, and outcome data structures.
Audited RustSymbolGameHost delegation to operating_system.adapters.rust_host.ffi, unmodified railway Result passthrough, and action dispatch methods.
Audited compute_graph_phi1 requirement of CORE_FUNCTIONAL_GRAPH_BIN and CORE_FUNCTIONAL_GRAPH_SHA256, hash verification, and zero fallback policy.
Audited main entrypoint exception handling converting RustFunctionalRequired into exit code 2 with stderr REFUSED message.
Audited RustFunctionalRequired exception and require_rust_functional boundary enforcement preventing Python metric calculation.

claims.statement: Input and preallocation bounds are enforced; the timeout is validated metadata with no internal watchdog.
dependencies: Input byte limits and stream reader prefix bounding in code/rust/pfp/src/main.rs.
Carrier dimension resource fences and dense matrix cell bounds in code/rust/pfp/src/protocol.rs.
Intake request validation and timeout metadata checking in code/rust/pfp/src/host.rs.
claims.limits: Applies to host intake bounds and declared timeout metadata; does not spawn an internal watchdog timer for process cancellation.

claims.statement: pfp/ffi.py calls the OS native seam and returns the complete outcome unmodified.
dependencies: Canonical host binary location delegation in pfp/ffi.py.
Unmodified railway Result forwarding from operating_system.adapters.rust_host.ffi in pfp/ffi.py.
claims.limits: Confirms passthrough preservation of native outcome mappings and typed refusals; does not authenticate the native binary's factual correctness.

claims.statement: The graph tutorial adapter requires its own executable path and SHA-256 pin.
dependencies: Executable path configuration via CORE_FUNCTIONAL_GRAPH_BIN in ops/adversary/infrastructure/providers/adapters/native_functional.py.
SHA-256 content verification via CORE_FUNCTIONAL_GRAPH_SHA256 in ops/adversary/infrastructure/providers/adapters/native_functional.py.
claims.limits: Enforces binary path existence and 64-character hex SHA-256 matching; does not provide source-to-binary compilation proofs or Python fallback.

claims.statement: run-turn, run-bout and run refuse before writing any functional.
dependencies: CLI command subparser routing in pfp/entrypoints/cli/parser.py and symbol_game.py.
Immediate failure closed via require_rust_functional in pfp/entrypoints/cli/run_commands.py and pfp/functional_boundary.py.
claims.limits: Verifies fail-closed refusal and zero disk writes for legacy CLI commands; does not implement replacement native commands.
